findings.evidence: AC4 requires Game Config to pre-select Rapid, which needs the speed field of E02-S11 (TASK-2.11, ordinal 124000); E12-S01 has ordinal 46000 and the sole dependency TASK-2.1. It also needs the Hand Review auto-open (E09-S01), style labels (E03-S03) and card colours (E03-S05), none listed as dependencies.
findings.fix: Remove the Game Config clause from AC4 (E12-S04#AC1 already tests the Rapid default) and add dependency edges for the table/review/card features the AC exercises, or split AC4 per setting into the owning toggle stories.

findings.evidence: AC6 asserts Settings shows auto-open on, four-colour off and banter on after reset, but those toggles are built by E12-S05 (161000), E12-S06 (162000) and E12-S07 (163000), after E12-S08 (138000). The AC cannot pass when this story is built.
findings.fix: Move the per-toggle default-after-reset assertions into each toggle story, or reword AC6 to check the stored settings records and add deps on the toggle stories.

findings.evidence: One AC bundles four settings defaults over a played hand, which makes failures hard to attribute.
findings.fix: Split per setting or keep defaults on the owning toggle stories (already in E12-S02/S05/S06/S07 AC1).

summary: All 19 clauses covered; round-1 findings resolved. Two hidden-dependency defects (S01#AC4, S08#AC6).
